scope: New estimation-procedure validation, not repair/pooling of the stopped fixed-GH61 PR123 experiment.
quadrature: Fit GH101 for EVERY hypothesis/dataset; independently constructed GH161 audit. Same1e-5 score/.001 logLik and native convergence/bounds/information gates; denser information check remains. No selective per-replicate density upgrade.
initialization: Use native deterministic default initialization uniformly for ALL datasets in the proposed main study. The successful current warm-start case is feasibility evidence only, not a homogeneous main-study observation. Prior GH61 estimates may be compared diagnostically, not counted as final GH101 results.
data: Same immutable DGP,2500 seeds/both impacts and archived response hashes; reuse data/ordinal outcomes only; preserve PR120-124 records unchanged.
stages: First10 seed pairs measure cold-start cost and native/dense gates; preregister approved cumulative budget before100/500/2500 expansion. No budget extrapolation from one warm-start case. No next-stage execution in this PR.
independent_validation: Finite-difference full-score checks on prespecified pilot/sentinel cases; native score and information/denser-grid checks on every fit. Never remove the1e-5 gate. All audit sampling and stopping fixed before outcomes.
statistics: Retain9-component CP/Hoeffding family and5 binary McNemar-Holm comparisons, paired interactions, failed-analysis sensitivity and fixed-R rules. No significance-based stopping or automatic CERTIFIED label.
failure: Stop on prespecified technical/scientific/resource failure; record all failures, no replacements. A need for uniformGH161 would require another version/protocol, not post-hoc rescuing selected outcomes.
production: No production/p-value gate change implied by this proposal; evidence for one dataset is not nominal FWER control.
